conviction.explanation: Low evidence confidence. Quarterly conversion improved, but neither side has primary commodity, production and cash evidence to establish repeatability or cycle reversal. The 6% H1 growth is a more conservative anchor than 67.2% Q2 growth. Neutral reflects genuine improvement with limited evidence quality. Conviction describes the current evidence, not a calibrated win rate; outcome memory has no observations.

executive_summary:
Sarawak Oil Palms improved Q2 profit conversion and raised its quarterly dividend to 5 sen. Quarterly earnings growth of 67.2% contrasts with only 6% H1 growth; the half-year is the more conservative anchor until production, selling prices and cash data establish repeatability. Maintain observation; the evidence does not yet establish a directional new-position advantage.

The longer-term uptrend is undergoing a correction, with price just below SMA-50 and a negative MACD histogram. Oversold RSI does not confirm a rebound, and volume at only 0.30 times average makes either accumulation or distribution difficult to establish. Sarawak Oil Palms has potential commodity-price sensitivity, but general commodity inflation cannot substitute for CPO prices or harvest evidence. The macro signal is neutral with low confidence. Quarterly conversion improved, but neither side has primary commodity, production and cash evidence to establish repeatability or cycle reversal. The 6% H1 growth is a more conservative anchor than 67.2% Q2 growth. Neutral reflects genuine improvement with limited evidence quality.
bull_case: Sarawak Oil Palms improved Q2 profit conversion, NAV per share and its quarterly dividend. Round two replaces extrapolation of 67.2% quarterly earnings growth with the more conservative positive H1 trend, conditional on production, selling-price and cash corroboration. Strongest disconfirming evidence to caution: Q2 profit/revenue rose to 10.54% from 7.03%, NAV/share increased and quarterly dividend rose to 5 sen, giving actual conversion and distribution evidence.
bear_case: Q2 growth far exceeds H1 growth of 6%, making repeatability uncertain. Round two accepts the margin improvement but stresses missing commodity, harvest, borrowing and FCF evidence, alongside inaccessible original attachments and an unconfirmed recovery.
